== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon (PC 2024 D-E1 card)]]. Compared with [[Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]]. The whole of the disc card and the whole of the D-E1 card, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>74164e0105d9e83a09d43f4cdfc77cb36ee5e97c</code>.
